property_summary: For any call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly later timestamp, the reference contract only drains its entire balance when the current block.number is divisible by 15 (so address(c).balance == 0 iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant changes the divisor to 16 and thus will differ for some block numbers (e.g. divisible by 15 but not 16).
change_summary: Change the modulo divisor from 15 to 16, altering which blocks trigger the transfer and thus the contract's final balance and observable behavior.
